iast: dharma-kṣetre kuru-kṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāś caiva kim akurvata sañjaya
verses.meaning: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what his sons and the Pandavas did once they had gathered, eager for battle, on the sacred field of Kurukshetra.

iast: mātrā-sparśās tu kaunteya śītoṣṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ
āgamāpāyino 'nityās tāṁs titikṣasva bhārata
verses.meaning: The senses meeting their objects bring cold and heat, pleasure and pain. These come and go and do not last, so learn to bear them.

deva: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः।
अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे॥
iast: na jāyate mriyate vā kadācin nāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ
ajo nityaḥ śāśvato 'yaṁ purāṇo na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre
verses.meaning: The self is never born and never dies. Unborn, eternal and ancient, it is not killed when the body is killed.

iast: karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi
verses.meaning: Your right is to the action alone, never to its results. Do not let results be your motive, and do not cling to doing nothing.

deva: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛjāmy aham
verses.meaning: Whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness rises, at that time I manifest myself.

iast: paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṁ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām
dharma-saṁsthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge
verses.meaning: To protect the good, to end the wicked and to re-establish righteousness, I appear in age after age.

iast: uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet
ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
verses.meaning: Raise yourself by your own effort and do not let yourself sink. The self alone is your friend, and the self alone your enemy.

deva: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।
iast: patraṁ puṣpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati
tad ahaṁ bhakty-upahṛtam aśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
verses.meaning: Whoever offers me a leaf, a flower, a fruit or water with devotion, I accept that offering made with love by a pure heart.

deva: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।
iast: adveṣṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca
nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣamī
verses.meaning: One who hates no being, who is friendly and kind, free from possessiveness and ego, steady in pain and pleasure, and forgiving.

deva: अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
iast: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja
ahaṁ tvā sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
verses.meaning: Set aside every other duty and take refuge in me alone. I will free you from all wrongdoing; do not grieve.
